text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
Mejiro Palmer is on a mission to recreate
herself
and reach a point where she can
run freely. Now,
it's time to show that
version of her to the world.

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Palmer
text_block_list.text:
Yeah! I wanna run more like my real self!
As best I
can, anyway.

text_block_list.name: Daitaku Helios
text_block_list.text:
Go out there and make your debut race
a real
party! ☆ Woo!

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Palmer
text_block_list.text: Oh sure, I'll try to do that t—

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Palmer
text_block_list.text:
Wait, hold up! You want me to go full
party mode
out of nowhere during my
debut?!

text_block_list.name: Daitaku Helios
text_block_list.text:
Wahey-hey! You bet I do! ☆ You've
gotta pump
those vibes sky-high from
the get-go so you can
make your mark,
y'know?!

text_block_list.name: Daitaku Helios
text_block_list.text:
You gotta step up, Palmster! Let the
world know
you're here! ☆ Go, go,
gooo! ♪

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Palmer
text_block_list.text:
I-I guess. Maybe it's better to treat this
like my
first day of school and make my
first impression
count.

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Palmer
text_block_list.text:
Okay! Thanks, Trainer. I'll head to the
paddock
now.

text_block_list.name: Mejiro McQueen
text_block_list.text: Pardon the intrusion.

text_block_list.name: Mejiro McQueen
text_block_list.text:
We've come to wish you good luck,
Palmer.

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Palmer
text_block_list.text: McQueen? Ryan?

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Ryan
text_block_list.text:
Give it all you've got. We're the only
Mejiros here
today, but...

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Ryan
text_block_list.text:
There're plenty of friendly faces rooting
for you
out in the crowd, 'kay?

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Palmer
text_block_list.text: Really? But who could that possibly...

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Palmer
text_block_list.text: Trainer! Look at that banner!

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
I do look and see about ten people
standing
around the paddock holding a
huge banner that
says "Let's go,
Mejiros!"

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Palmer
text_block_list.text:
They're Mejiro fans! Some've had our
backs for
ages now.

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Palmer
text_block_list.text:
I think I've seen them before, actually. I
didn't
want to let them down then and
really pushed
myself hard.

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Palmer
text_block_list.text:
Hmm... I appreciate their support and
all, but now
the pressure's really on! I
don't know if bringing in
the party vibes
will fly with them...

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Palmer
text_block_list.text: ...S-sure!

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Palmer
text_block_list.text:
U-um, hello everyone! I-I'm pleased to
be making
my official debut today and...
Oh, what the hey.

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Palmer
text_block_list.text:
Hiyaaa! I'm Palmer! ♪ Mejiro Palmer! ♪
I'm gonna
set the track on fire today,
fam!

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Palmer
text_block_list.text:
I'm a front runner like you've never seen,
not even
hills have got me beat! I...

text_block_list.name: Spectators
text_block_list.text: Um...

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Palmer
text_block_list.text:
Er, I mean, um... I hope you'll support
me.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
The buzzing energy around her causes
her
freestyling to fizzle out, but that
doesn't change
the fact that she had
come out of her shell a little.
